attributes.name: Abyssal Shortcut
attributes.powers:
Display this barrier next to a location; the barrier is defeated.

While displayed, immediately after a character at this location resolves an encounter, he may roll 1d6. On an even result, he may move. On an odd result, discard that many cards from the blessings deck.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barrier Abyssal Shortcut, change the second power to "While displayed, immediately after a character at this location resolves an encounter, he may roll 1d6. On an even result, he may move. On an odd result, discard that many cards from the blessings deck."
corrections.issue: On Abyssal Shortcut, who does "you" refer to: the person who defeated the barrier, or whoever's at the location where Abyssal Shortcut is displayed?
